# celestial object type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:celestialObjectType`](gmeow-celestialObjectType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/celestialObjectType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of a celestial location (one or more [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (e.g. a source classified as both 'star' and 'variable star') and must coexist as evidence.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) -> [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:celestialObjectType`](gmeow-celestialObjectType.md) from [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) to [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md), [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a celestial location by one or more [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) values; non-functional, so multi-source classifications coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid as a single constitutive kind and avoid encoding it as a [`CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) subclass.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) individuals; competing classifications coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### Examples

- ex:vega [`gmeow:celestialObjectType`](gmeow-celestialObjectType.md) [`gmeow:celestialObjectTypeStar`](../individuals/gmeow-celestialObjectTypeStar.md).
